LESSON: SAFETY CARE AND SAFETY

Grade: PP1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: ENVIRONMENTAL
Topic 4.2: Safety CARE AND SAFETY

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Safety CARE AND SAFETY. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.
